notes.title: Super Buckyball Tournament is back, Come give it a try!
notes.content:
Clear your calendar and fill your freezer with frozen pizza, because you’re not going to leave your PC for a week!

[b]Super Buckyball Tournament is back today, and you can play the demo here![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1059110/Super_Buckyball_Tournament!

Have you been twitching for the past 2 months since we closed the Preseason? Then you are about to get something to calm your nerves.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33359871/81c31883424ce1134ad92c69ab73aa01e24dfbca.png[/img]

[b]We open the gates to our new stadium and the rest of the package right now[/b]

And will leave it open until: Feb 9th 11:59PM PST 

Make sure that you don’t miss out on this special opportunity to try our new character Sky, play on our new stadium – Mist City and of course to battle your friends and foes in the highly anticipated 4v4 mode which takes the competition to a higher level.

[previewyoutube=TBQtt_RR8lM;full][/previewyoutube]
On top of that we also want to celebrate this beta with a tournament where all our enthusiastic Buckyballers get to throw down for cash prizes!

We welcome you to get your team together and signup for either of our 2 Tournaments:

EU Tournament Feb 7th,  5pm CET. Sign up [url=https://challonge.com/tournaments/signup/eaytlpvnv5#/signup/mz69hhh0rlk]Here[/url] 
US Tournament Feb 7th, 12pm PST. Sign up [url=https://challonge.com/tournaments/signup/yntWjnew3G#/signup/u6oipmvpcbq ]Here[/url]

If you do not yet have a team, do not fret. You can join our amazing [url=https://discord.gg/BAc8gvw]Discord[/url] Community to find new teammates!

See you all on the field!

- Pathea Games

notes.title: PATHEA GAMES KICKS OFF THE SBT PRESEASON TODAY
notes.content:
GET SBT PRE-SEASON [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341230]HERE[/url]!

Welcome back to the future where speed, strategy and intensity are sweeping across the world with fast-growing Sport; Super Buckyball Tournament. Everyone can join, no matter if you are human, android, robot or have had your DNA spliced with an animal. But beware that only the toughest have what it takes to make it to the top.

[previewyoutube=sRIqvwsgOJY;full][/previewyoutube]
[u][b]Features[/b][/u]

In addition to our six characters, two stadiums and mission system featured during the game’s open alpha earlier this year, the preseason will include:

•	New challenger Samba: This guy is the first Chimera on the field and being half tiger, he is someone to watch out for. He is now one of the strongest characters in the game and his ultimate which gives him a massive speed boost, makes him hard to catch up with.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33359871/064254f7431459c0648cb3060e85b5c43aa235c5.gif[/img]

•	2 Arcade modes: Dodgeball & Mayhem
These to modes will be unlocked when you reach lvl 6 and will rotate every 24 hours, meaning one mode will be available to enjoy every day.

•	Dodgeball challenges you to avoid getting hit by two balls while making sure those balls don’t rest on your side of the field for more than 12 seconds. 

•	Mayhem is a super-powered version of Standard mode, as abilities charge three times faster and players take control of random characters each time a goal is scored. 


[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33359871/2215cc640fe0254bd1d5de3e2a623d09cba32b47.jpg[/img]

•	New lobby with cool new UI and animated backgrounds. 

•	In-game background music has finally been added and with new sound effects for all characters, the game should definitely be experienced with the volume turned up.

•	a comprehensive collection of skins (which includes accessories and player icons), 

•	Season pass with 60 levels. You will now be able to level up this all new season pass by completing daily and weekly challenges and earn special rewards.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33359871/558a8c93dae66a7c81e49172826f2b114fe2f35e.gif[/img]

•	High Definition Render Pipeline (HDRP).
We have given the whole game a makeover and optimized it to HDRP which has improved graphics and performance and gives you a much smoother gaming experience.

Our player-friendly community where you can find new friends to play with, join special activities or challenge other players is on the official SBT [url=https://discord.gg/BAc8gvw]Discord[/url]

To keep up to date with all the latest information on Super Buckyball Tournament, pleas follow us on:

[url=https://twitter.com/SuperBuckyBall]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/SuperBuckyballTournament]Facebook[/url]
[url=http://www.instagram.com/superbuckyballtournament/]Instagram[/url]

If you like us want to see the game grow and succeed, a nice review would be a great help.
We would also be super stoked if you were to wishlist the full game Here.

Thanks for your support!!!

- Pathea Games

notes.title: My Time at Sandrock Announced Today!
notes.content:
ATTENTION: PATHEA GAMES NEEDS YOUR HELP!! PLEASE SUPPORT OUR[h1] [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1757963851/my-time-at-sandrock-us?ref=7542hn&token=dfc546fd ]KICKSTARTER.[/url][/h1]

[h2]Hey Sandrockers![/h2]

[b]My Time at Sandrock[/b] – Just like My Time at Portia, the game takes place in perhaps the only wholesome post-apocalyptic world in the gaming industry right now; a world where humans have successfully restarted civilization after, long ago, nearly destroying themselves through greed, unbridled technology, and warfare in a period they refer to as the “The Age of Darkness.” Current citizens of this world now band together and reject the Old World ideologies as they work to rebuild, but remaking an entire civilization isn’t easy…

[previewyoutube=aolJ3ZHzhCo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]First day on the job…[/b]
Taking a job offer in the frontier town of Sandrock, you’ll assume the role of a fledgling builder being sent to a wild and rugged townscape on the brink of collapse. It’s up to you and your trusty toolset to gather resources, build machines, fix up your workshop into a well-oiled production machine, and save the town from the jaws of economic ruin, as well as a few other unexpected complications...

[b]No job too big, no task too small![/b]
Customize and build your workshop with an intricate set of machines that all work together to produce parts of huge structures for the town that you assemble piece by piece; or head to your worktable to craft hundreds of unique items that can help out individual townspeople or be placed throughout your own workshop: watch Sandrock transform before your eyes as every contribution you make to town appears permanently in the world!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997750/407e2594aab1688c8ed88127260acc1d2d3b521d.jpg[/img]

[b]There and back again [/b]
Explore the vast deserts surrounding Sandrock: dive into ruins to find ancient relics from the Old World, face the dangers of dungeons and their denizens, then return to your homestead with encumbering bags of treasure in tow. Take your profits and convert the empty prairie lands around you into farmable land for a more leisurely lifestyle, then sell your crops, or transform them into delicious dishes to share with all your new friends in town!
 
[b]It takes a wild bunch…[/b]
The people of Sandrock are hardy and tenacious, and one can hardly survive in such an arduous climate without developing a sense of humor. Befriend the local sheriff to hear about his tall tales, help out the chatty ranch family and they’ll help you in turn, spend some time with a local artist and hear about her hopes and aspirations. Meeting and helping these characters leads to not only making new friends, but also people to support you in building your workshop! And who knows, even romance might be in the air…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38997750/a77e183ee5fd00442fa08a7f4a2b6f562299ea5d.jpg[/img]
 
My Time at Sandrock brings a plethora of new features to the table:
[list]
[*] [b]New Combat[/b] - a revamped combat system that allows the player to quickly shift between melee combat and 3rd person shooting mechanics.
[*] [b]Great Music [/b]- an original soundtrack with dynamic in-game music that reflects where the player is and what they're doing
[*] [b]More Elaborate Story and Deeper Characters[/b]- a vastly enriched storyline, hundreds of side-quests boasting over 30 completely new characters, each getting more attention than before with their own story to discover, as well as the return of a few familiar faces for fans of the series.
[*] [b]Build with Friends! Co-op multiplayer[/b] - Perhaps the most exciting addition to the game is a new multiplayer function that will finally allow players to visit a unique multiplayer map where they can build a workshop together and experience an additional storyline that unfolds there…
[/list]

Fans of the series will find everything they enjoyed about Portia and more, and new players will feel right at home in the delightful life-sim RPG that is My Time at Sandrock. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1084600/My_Time_at_Sandrock/
[h2][b]See you there and Rock on Sandrockers![/b][/h2]

notes.title: Ever Forward Release date CONFIRMED!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey gang! [/h1]Its official and we finally have a release date set! I feel like this is my wedding date lol. She said yes! Haha no, I’m joking…. [u][b]August 13th[/b][/u], Ever Forward will be released!!! The game starts at $14.99 and during the first week there will be a [b][u]10% discount.[/u][/b] 

[h3]We are full of gratitude, appreciation, and respect for the players that have supported us through this journey.[/h3]
We have taken the awesome feedback you guys gave for the demo prologue and tried to include all that in the final build. You all wanted a better tutorial, more puzzles and more interaction. We have done all that and more: there are many new puzzles that will absolutely blow your mind and challenge you until you’re blue in the face and ready to throw your controller... out of pure joy! We’ve also added a few challenge puzzles for galaxy brain IQ 200 players who think they can handle it. Spoiler: you can’t handle it. Better optimization, music and general polish will help the gaming experience be smoother and hopefully just a more enjoyable experience. 

[h3]For all you Maya fans-[/h3]New animation and actions for Maya will help you to solve puzzles faster. And of course, the full version of the game will bring you the thrilling conclusion to Maya’s narrative; you can finally know exactly what happened to her and why her world even exists… 

[h3]I must leave you with this…[/h3]  [i](Going back to work) [/i]
We want to make the best games we can make, for the people who will enjoy it. We whole heartily believe that games, especially in this day and age are essential to life and happiness for many people. When we’re in over our heads in life, games can be the winds in our sails to get back to safe waters. Often when dealing with adverse times, games are the best way to release the tension and pressures of life. For many of us, games are the light at the end of, sometimes, the dark tunnels life puts you in. It’s our duty and our joy to make dope games that are more than just entertainment. We take great honor and pride in the role we play as game developers. We want our games to excite people and be used as a platform for spreading love and happiness. Thus far this experience of connecting with gamers and hearing / seeing what people share and how they solve our puzzles has been the best part for us. None of us expected this community to be so impactful and supportive of our project, we are truly humbled. [h2]The Devs….[/h2]
